description: #53 CRIT-2: a private repository at Repair whose rules read answers 403 without the Pro message, as a rate limit does, so the case can't be decided and the private item fails closed.

habit_lines: 这次没能判断这个 private 仓库的规则是否生效：GitHub 的回答在重试一次后仍然没读到或读不懂，所以按未通过处理，运行停止。
解决办法：稍后再运行一次治理；在判断出规则生效之前，运行不会继续。
rules_in_effect.issue_line: Rules in effect can't be decided on Habit130/tally: the rules read stays unread after one retry (HTTP 403: API rate limit exceeded for user ID 1.); the run fails closed. Remedy: run again later.
